_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "client" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stakeholders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NULL, "area" TEXT NULL, "influence" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "technique" TEXT NOT NULL, "location" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned', "notes" TEXT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_participants" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id), "stakeholder_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stakeholders (id), "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "stakeholder_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "script_points" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id), "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "glossary_terms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "term" TEXT NOT NULL, "definition" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "term_sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_label" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recordings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id), "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'recording', "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sample_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 16000, "channels" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stopped_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "live_marks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transcripts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pass" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "model_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NULL, "failure_reason" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transcript_segments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transcript_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transcripts (id), "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
